The '''[[Netherlands Football League Championship]] 1951–1952''' was contested by 56 teams participating in four divisions. The national champion would be determined by a play-off featuring the winners of each division of the [[Netherlands]]. [[Willem II Tilburg|Willem II]] won this year's championship by beating [[Hermes DVS]], [[HFC Haarlem]] and [[AFC Ajax]].

==New entrants==
This season, there was one division less than in the last one. This meant that the team had to be reassigned.<br>
'''Eerste Klasse A:'''
*Moving in from other Divisions: [[AGOVV Apeldoorn]], [[ASV-DWV|DWV]], [[HFC EDO]], [[FC Twente|Enschedese Boys]], [[HVV 't Gooi]], [[HFC Haarlem]], [[Volewijckers|De Volewijckers]]
*Promoted from 2nd Division: [[USV Elinkwijk|Elinkwijk]] & [[Theole]]
'''Eerste Klasse B:'''
*Moving in from other Divisions: [[Achilles]], [[Be Quick 1887]], [[Blauw-Wit Amsterdam]], [[VV Leeuwarden]], [[RCH (football club)|RCH]], [[VV Sneek Wit Zwart|Sneek Wit Zwart]], [[Telstar (football club)|VSV]] and [[FC Zwolle|Zwolsche Boys]]
*Promoted from 2nd Division: [[Oosterparkers]]
'''Eerste Klasse C:'''
*Moving in from other Divisions: [[Roda JC|Bleijerheide]], [[FC Den Bosch|BVV Den Bosch]], [[Feyenoord|Feijenoord]], [[FC Eindhoven]], [[MVV Maastricht]], [[NAC Breda|NAC]], [[RBC Roosendaal]], [[Fortuna Sittard|Sittardia]] and [[Willem II Tilburg|Willem II]]
*Promoted from 2nd Division: [[DHC Delft]], [[Juliana (football club)|Juliana]] & [[Quick Nijmegen]]
'''Eerste Klasse D:'''
*Moving in from other Divisions: [[RKVV Brabantia|Brabantia]], [[VV Chèvremont]], [[Hermes DVS]], [[HBS Craeyenhout]], [[SV Limburgia]], [[Maurits (football club)|Maurits]], [[NEC Nijmegen]], [[PSV Eindhoven]] and [[VVV Venlo]]
